title: Skybound Boots
description: Skybound adds feathered boots 🥾🪶 that enhance your jump and let you perform a double jump ✨. Explore the Minecraft world with style, overcome obstacles, and reach new heights with ease and agility!
body:
# **Skybound**



Skybound is a mod designed to enhance your movement experience in Minecraft 🏞️. It introduces a new piece of equipment: the Feathered Boots 🥾🪶, featuring elegant side feathers that are not just cosmetic but hold a special power.

By wearing these boots, players gain the ability to perform boosted jumps and execute a double jump mid-air ✨, allowing them to reach new heights and overcome obstacles with ease. Whether exploring mountains, crossing canyons, or searching for new building paths, Skybound offers you unprecedented freedom of movement.

The mod is perfect for players who love vertical exploration and want to make every adventure more dynamic and spectacular 🌍. All materials and mechanics are carefully balanced to fit seamlessly into the vanilla Minecraft experience.
